The '''2025–26 Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Illinois at Urbana–Champaign|University of Illinois]] during the [[2025–26 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Illini, led by ninth-year head coach [[Brad Underwood]], played their home games at the [[State Farm Center]] in [[Champaign, Illinois]] as members of the [[Big Ten Conference]].

==Previous season==
The [[2024–25 Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball team|Fighting Illini]] finished the [[2024–25 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2024–25 season]] 12–8 in [[2024–25 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish in seventh place. They defeated [[2024–25 Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball team|Iowa]] before losing to [[2024–25 Maryland Terrapins men's basketball team|Maryland]] in the [[2025 Big Ten men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]]. They then got assigned the #6 seed in the Midwest region in the [[2025 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]]. They beat [[2024–25 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Xavier]] before losing to [[2024–25 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team|Kentucky]] in the second round.

==Offseason==
In May 2025, it was reported that the team would be hiring Camryn Crocker as assistant coach to replace Tim Anderson, who had left prior to the previous season and whose spot was temporarily filled by Kwa Jones.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/illinois/article/illinois-fighting-illini-basketball-camryn-crocker-assistant-coach-hire-colgate-249945083/ |title=Illini expected to hire Colgate assistant Camryn Crocker }}</ref> On June 16, Coach Underwood informed the media that Ty Rodgers had sustained a serious knee injury during a pick-up game in his hometown that would require surgery.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/illinois/article/fighting-illini-mens-basketball-ty-rodgers-out-indefinitely-with-knee-injury-illinois-head-coach-brad-underwood--250975348/ |title=Illini junior Ty Rodgers 'out indefinitely' with knee injury: 'There's no doubt it's tough for him' }}</ref> Rodgers underwent a successful surgery the following month.<ref>{{cite web|title=Ty Rodgers Injury update from Illini basketball coach Brad Underwood |date=23 September 2025 |url=https://armchairillini.com/ty-rodgers-injury-update-from-illini-basketball-coach-brad-underwood/}}</ref>

On July 9, the team announced the hiring of [[Kevin Kruger]] as Assistant to the Head Coach.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://fightingillini.com/news/2025/7/9/mens-basketball-underwood-adds-kruger-to-fighting-illini-staff.aspx |title=Underwood Adds Kruger to Fighting Illini Staff |date=9 July 2025 }}</ref>

In September, it was reported that Andrej Stojaković had been sidelined with a sprained knee.<ref>{{cite web|title=News from Illini tip-off event: Stojakovic sidelined with knee sprain |date=September 3, 2025 |url=https://www.news-gazette.com/sports/news-from-illini-tip-off-event-stojakovic-sidelined-with-knee-sprain/article_86b58dcf-9489-4b00-9393-c12c6843185a.html}}</ref> The following month, Tomislav Ivišić underwent a tonsillectomy and Mihailo Petrović sustained ankle and hamstring injuries, leading to both players missing the Illini's exhibition against Illinois State.<ref>{{cite web|title=Notebook: Ivisic tonsillectomy another hurdle to UI chemistry-building; Boswell's Greece trip with Stojakovic |url=https://247sports.com/article/tomislav-ivisic-tonsil-removal-illinois-fighting-illini-basketball-mihailo-petrovic-andrej-stojakovic-kylan-boswell-256175750/}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Illinois basketball missing key starters for exhibition game against Illinois State |date=October 18, 2025 |url=https://writingillini.com/illinois-basketball-missing-key-starters-for-exhibition-game-against-illinois-state}}</ref>

|first=Joey |last=Wagner |date=January 20, 2026 |website=247sports.com}}</ref>
